title: export cancellation and codec report pills

commit.merge_subject: merge: export cancellation and codec report pills

description:
Owner request 2026-11-13 ("device report'taki codec
çeşitlilikleri ekranda düzgün görüntülenmiyor" — the
device report's codec varieties were not displaying
properly): the codec list leaves the settings main screen.

The "Device report" ListItem stays where it was and now
opens a dialog (the app's plain M3 AlertDialog pattern —
Library delete, gyro picker; no nav-graph addition) that
shows every codec as a separate pill: one stock M3
AssistChip per codec in a FlowRow wrap list (stable since
foundation 1.7, this BOM's artifacts still carry the
ExperimentalLayoutApi marker — opt-in scoped to this file),
codec name as the label, HW/SW as the leading marker, the
full formatReport line (kind, profiles, max size, 10-bit)
as the chip's accessibility description so the pill stays
scannable and the detail stays one TalkBack step away. The
chip's tap closes the dialog — AssistChip is a clickable
s
changed: feat: cooperative export cancellation in the queue
feat: cancel actions on live export rows
feat: codec list as pills in a device report dialog
